zh:
- Windows 托盘截止摘要现在遵循常驻消息栏开关，关闭后会移除托盘图标。
- Windows 托盘剩余时间支持按天或按小时显示，并与设置中的单位选择保持一致。
- 更新语言、任务或时间设置后，托盘摘要会自动同步。
en:
- The Windows tray deadline summary now follows the persistent notification toggle and removes its icon when disabled.
- Windows tray remaining time supports the day/hour preference from settings.
- The tray summary now syncs automatically after language, task or time-setting changes.
